Peter, A few weeks ago, I told you we started the general election on empty — that we spent everything we had to win the primary. Here's what I didn't make clear: the other side never stopped raising money. Valadao didn't have a competitive primary and is sitting on nearly _$3 million_ thanks to corporate PACs and special interests who write checks year-round, election or not. We don't have that kind of money machine. We built ours one grassroots donor at a time. And we have to rebuild it again now that we are in the general election. **The fact is, we're at a disadvantage.** I know it's tempting to think that's just how things work, that money always wins. You’ll never convince me of that, but we have to be willing to fight for it. Which is why I need to ask: **[Tonight marks our mid-July fundraising deadline and we're not yet halfway to our goal for the month. I need your help closing that gap. I’m sitting here alone staring at our latest reports, and I’m struggling. I usually try to stay strong for the team, but looking at these numbers...**_I’m_**** __distraught__**** _._**
The truth is, we are much further behind than I ever imagined. It’s a weight I can’t carry alone anymore. I fear that we’re letting you down and failing our mission.
I’ve spent the last few days trying to find a way out, and I’ve finally reached the point where I have to humble myself and ask for help. **_[I’ve poured the full truth into a private note for you here:](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)_**

I wouldn't ask if it wasn't urgent, but time is ticking. I hope you'll understand.
Best, Katie

name: Melat Kiros
subject: Denver was not an isolated victory.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Justice Democrats
body:
This movement’s next fight is in MI-13
#
I want to tell you about my friend Donavan McKinney.
A few weeks before our election, Donavan came to Denver and stood beside us while millions in dark money poured into our district in an effort to crush our campaign and silence us.
**Yesterday, I was in Michigan rallying with Donavan and fellow Justice Democrat Chris Rabb, because that same political machine that tried to stop us has picked Donavan as its next target.**
Donavan is running for Congress in Michigan’s 13th District, one of the most underserved districts in America and a place built by working people who clock in shift after shift while billionaires, corporations, and career politicians get richer off their labor.
He knows that struggle because he lived it too, and now he serves in the Michigan House, fighting for workers, families, and communities that Washington has abandoned for decades.
_And that is exactly why the establishment is terrified of him._
His multimillionaire opponent has been propped up by AIPAC and the same network of billionaire donors, corporate interests, and dark money PACs that spent millions trying to defeat us. They are flooding this race with money and attacks because they know what happens when working people elect someone who cannot be bought.
**These groups know Denver was not an isolated victory, that Donavan can win, and that if we keep winning races like this, their grip on the Democratic Party starts to break.**
**[So if you can, I’m asking you to come through for Donavan the way you came through for me by splitting a contribution between his campaign and Justice Democrats today.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260715-2-dm.cf9Tdj&refcode=em20260715-38033&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=38033%2E1203867%2E3-EEke)**
**[Contribute $10](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260715-2-dm.cf9Tdj&refcode=em20260715-38033&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=21&akid=38033%2E1203867%2E3-EEke)**
Donavan showed up for us when powerful forces were trying to erase our movement. Now they are betting that the rest of us will look away while they do the same thing to him.
_We cannot let them win that bet._
From Denver to Detroit, we are building a movement that refuses to settle for corporate Democrats who serve billionaires while working families fall further behind.
**[I’m standing with Donavan in Michigan, but we need you standing with us, too.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260715-2-dm.cf9Tdj&refcode=em20260715-38033&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=38033%2E1203867%2E3-EEke)**
— Melat

name: James Carville
subject: Democrats have needed this for a long time.
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve spent nearly half a century helping Democrats win elections, and I’m gonna tell you something plainly:
For too long, we have waited until the house was already on fire before deciding to buy a hose.
We wait until a race becomes a crisis.
We wait until a great candidate is getting buried in attack ads.
We wait until Republicans have already built the infrastructure, raised the money, and defined the battlefield.
Then everybody starts running around asking what happened.
Well, Raja Krishnamoorthi has gone and done something about it.
He founded Equal Opportunity Now [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email] to find and support bold leaders and important causes before it’s too late — leaders who will stand up to Donald Trump and the MAGA movement, fight for working families, and actually deliver results.
And all I can say is:
FINALLY.
Finally, an organization that understands we cannot defeat MAGA with timid candidates, stale talking points, and a last-minute panic.
But Raja cannot build this by himself.
Will you contribute $25, $50, or whatever you can today to help Equal Opportunity Now find, fund, and support the leaders Democrats need to start winning again? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
SUPPORT EQUAL OPPORTUNITY NOW! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Now, I know Raja.
He is smart. He is tough. And he knows firsthand what opportunity can mean.
His family came to this country with very little. They relied on public housing and food stamps. He worked his way from Peoria all the way to Congress.
And instead of pulling the ladder up behind him, Raja has spent his career fighting to make sure the next family gets the same shot.
That means standing up for workers.
Holding powerful corporations and corrupt politicians accountable.
Defending immigrants, voting rights, and every American targeted by Trump’s politics of division.
And now he is putting that experience toward building the next generation of Democratic leadership.
Here’s the truth: The leaders we need are already out there.
They are running for city council, state legislature, Congress, and offices most national donors are not paying attention to yet.
They have the courage.
They have the ideas.
What they do not always have is the money, infrastructure, and early support necessary to compete.
That is where Equal Opportunity Now comes in.
Please chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can today to help Raja build the organization Democrats should have built years ago. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
HELP DEMOCRATS WIN: DONATE TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
We’ve got a good battle plan, now, let’s help Raja build this damn thing.
-- James Carville
Visit Our Website To Learn More! [https://www.equalopportunitynow.org/]

**_Mike’s original email:_**
Peter, the affordability crisis in this country is spiraling out of control. Families are struggling to afford healthcare, housing, gas, groceries and other basic necessities. That’s why I introduced the American Affordability Act to help put money back into Americans’ pockets across the board.

My legislation lowers costs for housing, energy, healthcare, childcare and education costs through a series of commonsense tax credits and deductions.

**_[Add your name now to support my efforts to lower costs. Your signature adds urgency to my message that we need concrete solutions to fix the affordability crisis in our country. **[SUPPORT LOWER COSTS](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135345346/633967638/868073187?source=EM_NBI_MT_20260715_PT_AffordabilityBill_0_3MO_TeamThompson_NA_NA_NA-2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDQ0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYjYwOTliYS1iMjgwLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IwnjopK5o7-DK30e03AGiOeLGgdUDgbpQBBnzNZyvp8=&emci=de6099ba-b280-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=fb6099ba-b280-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=2678920)**
Gas, food, and rent prices across the country are hitting unprecedented levels. We need to do everything we can to make progress towards affordability.

But I’m not looking to make a quick fix. I want to build long-term economic security for families through my American Affordability Act. It will give tax credits to make housing more affordable, assist with childcare and adoption expenses, help lower monthly healthcare costs, and even expand tax credits for education.

Everyone will benefit from the American Affordability Act. **It’s about time we all come together to start fighting for the American people.**

This is just the first step, Peter. There are just 20 days left until our August 4 primary election, Peter.

Our primary isn't the finish line—**it's the first step.** I could give you a hundred reasons as to why we need to turn out strong. Instead, I'll give you just one: _America can't afford to wait any longer for new leadership in the House._

After August 4th, we will turn our full attention to the fight ahead in November. **But it all starts by building the strongest campaign we can over these next 20 days.**

Every day, families are paying more for necessities like groceries and gas than they should. Every day, our rights and freedoms face new attacks. Every day, we see Republican politicians in Washington, DC choosing partisan politics over solving the problems people actually face. Every day we witness more grift and corruption from the Trump administration without as much as a raised eyebrow from the Republican majority. And the sooner we win our primary, _the sooner we can get to work holding this seat and flipping the House in November._

I left my pediatrics practice in 2018 and ran for Congress under circumstances similar to those we face right now: Donald Trump unrestrained by his party. But things are even worse now. He's not just reckless; he's vengeful. He's surrounded by loyalists and sycophants, emboldened in his second term, and unafraid to abuse power. He's also working hard to tip the scales in the upcoming midterm election.

But it is hard to sow doubt about an election with overwhelming turnout and a decisive Democratic victory. That's why, over the next 20 days, our campaign will be working nonstop to reach voters across WA-08. name: Dan Cox
subject: Wes Moore's PJM Price Cap Offers No Relief To Marylanders
body:
, Today, Wes Moore announced he is extending price caps on PJM, but this is no solution or help to Maryland's energy crisis. | |
---
| | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:

WES MOORE’S PJM COST CAP EXTENSION OFFERS NO RELIEF OR SOLUTION TO MARYLAND’S ENERGY CRISIS**

Frederick, MD – July 15, 2026

Governor Wes Moore is celebrating an agreement that extends electricity price cap rates through 2030 as though it is a victory for Maryland families. It is not. _**This extension is a political cover-up, not energy relief.**_ Maryland families are still being forced to pay electric bills of _**$600, $800, and even over $1,200 a month.**_ Wes Moore touts his $12.50 per month in average savings; however, while those same caps remain in place, BGE has already requested another average $8-per-month increase from state regulators. _**Marylanders don’t need a political spin.**_ They need lower electric rates through more reliable, affordable power generation--not temporary caps that leave today’s unaffordable bills largely unchanged. Families and businesses are experiencing growing concerns over grid reliability, an inadequate supply of electricity to meet increasing demand, and an energy policy that leaves our state less prepared for future growth. Maryland deserves an abundant, reliable, and affordable energy supply. Instead, **_Wes Moore implements policies that normalize high prices._** Governor Moore's plan manages the symptoms while leaving the underlying problem untouched.

A Dan Cox administration will take a different approach. Instead of capping already outrageous costs, we will work to reverse them. We will pursue policies that increase Maryland's electricity supply, restore dependable generation where feasible, and expand access to affordable, reliable, and responsible energy. More available power means greater reliability, increased competition, and lower costs for Maryland families and businesses.

Marylanders should not have to structure their household budgets around overwhelming electric bills. Those hard-earned dollars should be available for buying a home, saving for retirement, taking a family vacation, investing in a child's education, or building a stronger financial future.

**_Maryland can once again be a state where affordable, dependable energy fuels economic growth instead of draining family budgets. That is the difference between managing a crisis and solving one._**

## US Launches New Wave of Iran Strikes
The U.S. military [launched a new wave of strikes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb0TwwGAGhi7e0rWjRcxz_FqMI6CJ_PeVq_5Btytd6UjnfFyna6BE-f4eNvRt2aeMr5qwNSznpBJybYW-sIZyx9wohxtOIMBwYbk0UwyUjkl30S-IgKpDL-2gpTPaim71gIsFFXupQJjoQPcBFjf3SgUZ0cmO_EkTVhophNXDJfbqdhNqNk5JHOaBaYGR2l4unzvltuKSjv2J5TLvW5f82tqjMvXGYGQwthVXSun8GIyPPdF8MBgjLpgrMhh7ZxxYzb8r3yhRC-Xgf4b8tOVUU8iRwdgVHx8vSomqsUyL-xboF9y1f5V6evgJAAD__4rifL8) against Iran Wednesday morning, firing precision munitions at coastal defense systems and cruise missile sites on Greater Tunb Island in a 90-minute operation that ended at 7:30 a.m. ET. The strikes mark the fifth consecutive day of U.S. attacks aimed at degrading Iran's ability to threaten commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump [reinstated a naval blockade](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMFuhCAYhJ8GbxhAFvDAoRdv22uPBuVXaREM_rtm-_QNTd-gt0km-SbffNzHuwsxpPXd7WBxyWOC64yACKXGUFw6sYQvOF1ZIWFIboJRMKEo05Sr0bsQX6NsvF0ABHQNWK6N5L2SmjWb7RksneDKOc6MF30v-Wx0r27cSCkXaIKtNKa54oxpaVp_66aJdbPqOw5mNkQy8AFzaT9zSLjBEl_5CaWd895EuyEeJ-neiBiIGK7rauc0zbUkYqhoIgamiRj4jYgBy2M_aNWiWy7745v-6dEjX1DoEV3Ck2K1RfDthntsivXHFWIMp9JEsnV3If6u478ue1rxEwAA__9VDH-S) on Iranian ports Tuesday and warned that power plants and bridges would be targeted next week if Tehran does not return to negotiations. In an [interview with Fox News](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ugzAUhZ_GbETGBhsGD13Y0rUjMviCb-ufyL5JlD59RV6h25Xup3P0na_rcrUYMB2fNoKhPS8JnjUAEZTzxGJTpYI_UG05IBEmu8IiuFAt122nFmcxvJa-cWYHECAbMJ0e-25SveaNN5OWzkqnRjls4yjdOjiuoduU3pxQfG_QnGlcd6rjXPfjxQ1yXbnc1CQ7GLeR9RwcUi6X74yJPOzhlR9QLluOTTCe6FaZ_GBiZmImDx5DOH9MzD5HOIWYmK2LmLBSsYQ5MTEPk5qklC2Ve7y1p2ib4MiEb6C2J4rU-lzi_ZeJuSnG3Z4YAlalWc-PaPHd09C_hnsY8RcAAP__IteDww), Trump said the Iranian regime was "evil," adding _" I don't want to negotiate now. I said, 'Let's not negotiate.' Three days ago, we had a deal."_
## $1 Trump Coin Coming for America's 250th
The U.S. Mint has begun producing a [new $1 gold-colored coin](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uxCAUhE-DOyz-FnBBkcbdpk1pYfzsfQkGC9i19vaRc4V0nzTSjOb7uk93jxHT9ul3cG3NU4KzRmgNyoVYfKqt4A9UXzZIDZOfYRJMaMoM5XpaPMb3pLrFrQACZAeOG6v4oJVh3cPJWQ72JmfBZWBGDSYM3EpYLVdMarV26K42ZrjmjBll--Um55nJoAfJwQZLFIMFWy79d8bUHrDGd35B6UPeu-gerR2VyA8iRiLG8zz7MNfrxZUTMV5IxMjpluNCQ8ZEW3nuB119APqsdMfUiBi74pbjxBixakMU23aP8W-j_UvMy4nfAAAA__8-_Hav) bearing President Trump's likeness to mark America's 250th birthday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced Wednesday. List: Impacts of Permanent Daylight Saving Time Congress' push to make daylight saving time permanent will have varying impacts and the differences across states, and seasons, can be dramatic. Under the Sunshine Protection Act just passed by the House, winters would shift noticeably. Sunsets in much of the country would push past 5 p.m. even in December. The tradeoff: winter sunrises in cities like Seattle would not come until 8:38 a.m., Cleveland 8:31, and Billings, Montana, nearly 9 a.m. Here's in 20 cities and a map displaying the status of clock legislation in all 50 states. Nineteen states have already passed laws to lock their clocks on permanent daylight saving time, while more than a dozen others have introduced bills going the opposite direction, toward permanent standard time. ## Tornado Hits San Antonio Amid Flooding
A tornado [touched down Wednesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u6zAMBeCnsTcb1M-17EHDXbKla0eDCelYqCIFEhs7b1-4yBt0JYhz8J3P83zGEEO6feCdvexLnhNvNbIIl1lySUh5DVIrJkySU8gxpK9Zgx46cJ0aZsIQX7NtyV-AJtWyV260apocmHb1ejSEDsBY46xVVx70aP9No0PlFkRogz_CwKlBKVAWeiLUQIYWuhq0F9NYYAqSSy8rC-9Yl_jKTy79Nd_b6FeRR23M_0afGn3atq1f8q6HNX9Xyel4Os6MsnJp9OmN6g5VVzF1b1dbPD22EGOog2ss3O4Y4m-F_G2Yp9c_AQAA___9onle) near The Rim in northwest Bexar County, [damaging an apartment complex](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQhZ_GdF7ZYy4sBUUadzdtSmQ8w8W6Xs_KnsDu20dEeYPU5-j8fL8-l8-QcipfP8ODZnltvBQ6WyYRqotwLQF5T9JaKKEIl8Q5le8FDAzajNoOC4aU30vf4bwanGxHsx3vvZ2m0bhunx18rOCm7W4MGMLNuLuL0zpgtNuIuHZpvsLMaAdrje3NDTGAQYcbRhf61aneECbhepOdhF6hbfnNB9Vb5EeX513k2ZT7ocAr8Od53r5bkEtU4K83CnzmGLICf1Up8GZU4O2HAn9ZdeRSKIo-Ep1Um257qKSfOws3fSQkbpo3_Q-HTkUXrrKf1ESv9ApVR_5d5K3Ad3XG55lyTm0YVW--HiHlv0Pl__AeM_wJAAD__-qdkVk) and businesses as slow-moving storms continued to drench South Texas and the Hill Country. The heaviest rain, up to 16 inches, has fallen in Uvalde County, where officials reported [25 high-water rescues](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkEHSoyAQRk-DOyxAxLhgMRt3_2xnaXXsjlIhYEGPJrefSio3mAu873vvz8_8AyGGtP6GB3l-3vKc6KyRmKnMnEsCzFvgWiFB4pxCjiHdZ6OMk2qQ2s0IIb5m26C_Khx1Q14PF6vHcVBds3nXLco6ZyxaBNPb3ikYLpfriNQ7tSxN8G-YGrTTWmmrWkQwCju84dKBvXbCKsLAubS8EdMT6i2-8kGlXfKjiX5j3qvofgkzCTOd59ne11RbPoSZ3mhhJjUIM-lemGkjOF6yQEhV3ol2iYXSsoW0ypr_8iY_A_JrLgvtuTChrJDkN4AwU1M87meIMVQ3CKvWB4T4ucP_F_Hw5l8AAAD__xinh34) by Wednesday morning. A Flash Flood Emergency was later declared for Boerne, where [crews pulled residents](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQRk9jOpBtHIwLF9vQZdst0YCHMIpjI3s2JLdfsVf4y09P-p70_tznO1Ck9PgNL_T82fKc8KwRmbHMnEuCkHfiWiFB4pwoR0rPWUs9tNK2apgDUPzOpgl-kcGpBr2yo1HOWdk3u18W48AuPerb5py6mdWOEqTdRjWOo1MN-etMWjUoJZWRXQigZejDFtYezNILIzEQ59LxjowfqFv85jeWbs2vJvqd-aii_yX0JPR0nmf3rMAXvCYC71iEni6L0JO0Qk_qdiFgLG3Buv7F2u5wHJgoPVpK7ZKxJBR6aooPx0kxUh2sMPLxAor_vfyzWm-v_wUAAP__6y9-Dg) from rising water near Main Street. No deaths or injuries have been reported. Governor Greg Abbott [issued disaster declarations](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u2zAQhE9DdTT4I4tRwSKNupc2pbDSLi3CNCmQa-s5pw_kK7xqigHmm5m_X_MXxBTz7Q88yPN3KHOmoyVipjpzqRmwbJFbgwyZS44lxXyfjTKDVE7qYUaI6T33HfpF4ag78tr96vU4OmW7zbvRLFcLIcC4kF2dIrWofsRgsSc7XLvozzDl9KC10r26IIJRaDHgaqFfrOgVYeRSL7wR0ze0kN7lRfWylkeX_Ma8N2F_CzMJMx3Hcbk34NMUZjrXnAIcS4YkzHTShJmUE2bSV2GmjeD1lhVibvJOtEuslNct5pts5cmb_DAlBKYqsRx5L8_aZCKUXCSWf5SbLEFWauuTTlpXPe5HTCm2wYle3R4Q06ct_-zjlzf_AwAA__8l3ZNP) for dozens of counties, and Kerr County officials said they are in contact with summer camps along the Guadalupe River, where floods killed more than 130 people last year.
## ICE Shooting Fallout Widens in Houston
President Trump on Wednesday said ICE agents should [resume most vehicle stops](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAQhJ_GZB75DxgCgkvI9tILUdttD631YGT3LDtvf2JfYdMq6VPV9-9j_QDKtD_-wjPO_J3Kusez5cgc68ql7oBlI24Ndti57FQy7Z-rUWaQapR6WBEov1fX4ewVTrqLsx7vTk_TqGy3zbEHnRJ4sN5MynpMyozOeIXa312wHc0XTI160Fppp26IYBRaTBgsOG-FUxGJS73xFjl-Q0v5Xb5ivYXy7PK8MR9N2D_CLMIs53nePrfyukphFqhMIUdhluuXMEsuAbIwC0bA_JYUomxbKUz7Q5iF6-t5_IRcISUKsnE5mjxKpvCWB7zaxTL3XsZ7mhI4LyMMTrrUOzkNk5O2H0LwvU2IQ1dnPE7KmdowCqceT6D8M5t_J_trNv8DAAD__zNXlHs), apparently opposing a pause prompted by fatal shootings in Houston and Maine. The pause followed the July 7 death of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, 52, who was [shot by an ICE agent](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O3CAUhZ8Gd4wAe_1TUKRxt2lTWtdwGdAyXAtuxjNvHzlKnmCbUx195-fX5_YJKady_wkPtPwKtBU8W0ZmrBtTLeApJm4NChSmkiin8rUZZUapJqnHzUPK723ovN2VX3SHVk_zoJdlUn0XrXbjspgP0C7Mu5pDmHWv52WEMH_sGPou2QumJj1qrfSgbt6DUb73wbsehr0Xg0KfmOqNIzK-oIX8pifWm6NHl21kPprofwizCrOe53lzObkvE-l3YyqXS5j1miXMmslBFma9MoVZ1fRfIsLzLTOcEkug6vCBheVRsWFxKCseVBm9TEUiNJb_6LJgusedaiTywqxdtf44U86pjZMY1P0BKf8tyt-792nNnwAAAP__GpWRbg) during a stop of his work van in Houston's East End. The Department of Homeland Security says Salgado Araujo rammed a law enforcement vehicle, and the agent fired in self-defense. Attorneys for the three surviving passengers dispute that account, saying no agent was in the van's path and the shots came from the side. The FBI has obtained [a warrant to search the van](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO5CAQBNCvwRkjaGNjBwSXONtLL7TadNtGy8AKuPHOff1p5hc2flKpqv58rB8YYkjHb7yza997XhNfNXJrXNaWS0LKZ2i1YsLUcgo5hvS5goJRKiv1uBKG-FxNR25TNOuOnbaT0fNsVd-dDu0EXrPhfWLkbaCeBw9sFXlAbakL7hWmrB61VtqoGxGCop528j2arRdGMYWWy62d3Pgb6x6f-cHl5vO9i-5s7auK_peARcByXdft88x_XyhgwdKCjyxgee0SsMTsMQpYiJHiUwbPsp45t5COtxZO_7KsGA-kLPctyAcmWRmLP-WFpWBqAhaYBukHtY2otNQ0kTTWb3I2I0sz7bx5mMko7IqjryvEGOpohVHHHUN8F28_u_vh4H8AAAD__9dIlXM). Harris County District Attorney Sean Teare says his office has issued dozens of subpoenas and is "more than prepared" [to file charges](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL_OnDAQxJ8GOiP_CxyFizR0lzYlWuwFnPi8yN477vL0Ed8rfN1IM_ppZn7f5zvEFPP2Cx7o-L3SnPGsCZmxzEwlQ6A9cq2QITPlSCnmv7OWuhdyEKqfA8T0mW0b3CLDqFp0arhZNY6DNO3u_GotKrMEg9Li6vsBx35Qi15v8KM30EZ3weSgeqWksrILAbQMJqzBG7CLaazEEJlKxzsyvqGu6UMvLJ2nR5vcznzUxvxs9NTo6TzPzi_1WnH5jZ4u2ehpp2dlyuIoVNE_mYqIHkXdiTjmTSQqmP-RqJA2CCSgwPMPiaPgAQWDYBJLuYJ-h7LhhWyLC8cZU4q1HxortwfE9NWKv_fly-n_AQAA__8F5o3_) if it finds criminal wrongdoing. Federal officials have not named the agent who fired.
## Paxton Investigates LinkedIn Over 'Ghost Jobs'
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton opened an [investigation into LinkedIn](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O5CAUhE-DM1r82NgEDjZxNptuaAHvuf22MbSAac_cfuWW9gQTVVCqT_rqz8f64ShSuv92B87ta8trwrNGbA3L2nJJDvJOrVaXXGo5UY6UHqsSynAxcmlWcBS_176D2QuwssNZjlMvrR2F7vbZS21wkDiBgCEIbzUgDJNBsHYI09DRfMHEKI2UQvbiBuCUAA0bBO16r1kvEKjlcms7NvxydYvf-YXlFvLRxXlv7VmZ_sXUwtRynuftETC111UztbjSKERkarnMmFpiDi4ytbxR_5O7O7_MECjxzT2QH1QjOqB053-zr_xZ8KDPg9dPX0Mhj-UaK2O5H0BrAMvReMP7wVhuBz1yCCPKMIH049aVGZ4nxUjVjKwX98NRfAu0n93-mtW_AAAA__8RBJgW) over claims that the platform advertised and profited from fake job listings, known as "ghost jobs," that were shown to paying Premium subscribers. His office issued a [Civil Investigative Demand](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMQL8GuqAkMGQoUlwz3V57JTJrA74JCUp8MPP3J1Z3X7CdZT1Z7_nXx_gBHDguP2EjL685jZHOEkiE8igpR8C0spQCEaKkyClwfI5W215pp0w_InB4j12NftI4mJq8cffODIPTbb36YXaT0_cb3cwdiCwNdGsdkqXpNgy9rtlfx7QzvTHadLpBBKuxxRk_W-imtuo0IUvKjawk9IIyh3c6KDefaauDX0X2UrU_Kvuo7OM8z-YLArn06b1QpAyhWdJR2cdVV9lHpkBQ6Br_c-ofqJ4U1Q4vSVFxPKgILyBU1BVOyFEBHpSFC8dFzfAkBRHVxiUQ4LX7nSaV9j1l-RNZmEqdPe4nh8Cld1Wnlw04fNnL935-ePs3AAD__wZEnjM) for documents on LinkedIn's advertising, verification practices, and Premium subscriptions, which run $39.99 to $69.99 per month.
